# testdata — not shipped

Parser and scanner fixtures. **Not** copied into `publish/`.

| Path | Use |
|------|-----|
| `mock/` | Fake Steam / Epic / registry trees for tools and tests |
| `samples/` | Real-format ACF / Epic `.item` dumps for parser research |

Application defaults stay in `data/` (`blacklist.json`, `tag_colors.json` only).
